name: [LLM] Prompt too large — over 10,000 tokens in one call

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM traces-*
| WHERE service.name == "apex-rag-demo" AND attributes.apex.prompt_tokens > 10000
| KEEP @timestamp, attributes.apex.question_id, attributes.apex.mode, attributes.apex.prompt_tokens, attributes.apex.cost_eur
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 10
